name: Common Sense
source:
Main character is a painter, actor and guitarist who does not sell, so he parasites on his wife while not doing any work himself. But wife gets fired from her work. And rumors start to appear.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名卖不出作品的画家、演员兼吉他手。他自己无所事事，靠妻子养活。然而，妻子丢掉了工作，流言也开始四处传播。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-october-2008-volume-7.html]vndbreview[/url]]
